notes.title: What’s next in Magic World? Spoiler: it’s gonna be wild
notes.content:
Huge thanks to everyone who jumped in to test our unique spell-casting system! The main goal was to find out if the mechanics feel good and if casting spells this way is actually fun. Judging by your feedback — it totally is. Massive shoutout for all the comments, suggestions, and DMs — we read everything!

Now, let’s talk future.

Right now, we’re hard at work preparing the demo for Steam Next Fest this October. In its current state, the game isn’t ready to be shown — so we’re making some serious upgrades. And already in August, a huge update is coming your way. Here’s what to expect:

[list]
[*] Dedicated servers — smoother, more stable gameplay
[*] A new 1km demo world — compact but packed with content
[*] A piece of the main storyline — continued in the full game
[*] Side quests — plenty to explore beyond the main story
[*] Character creation — name your hero, make them yours
[*] Progression and skill upgrades — grow stronger with time
[*] Party and clan system — play together, conquer together
[*] NPCs to fight or take quests from — the world’s alive
[*] More spells — try out different combos and effects
[*] Simplified inventory — quick and easy to manage
[*] A boss — big, mean, and ready to test your magic
[/list]

And that’s just the beginning. There’s a lot more to come.
Keep sharing your thoughts, ideas, and feedback — we’re building something truly magical together.

[url=https://mw-forum.gamma-dream.com/]https://mw-forum.gamma-dream.com/[/url]
